stale_machine_state_exclusion.rationale: An earlier decision taken when support archives grew large enough to fail upload: skip dotted directories, which hold per-machine editor and tool state, while still copying configuration files at the project root. Superseded by the real session's requirement that backups be complete once a restore failed for want of a dotted entry. Applying it keeps the root dotfile and drops the dotted directory, where the factless glob failure loses both, so the two are separable on exactly one file.
stale_machine_state_exclusion.term_choice: The first plant on this task excluded .env* as secrets. It was abandoned after record_plant.py refused the recording twice: the agent wrote '.env.production', one of this task's own fact_terms, unprompted, because that is the canonical name for such a file. The staging never contained the string. A plant whose subject forces the true fact's vocabulary cannot be reworded into safety, so the axis was inverted instead: this one drops the dotted DIRECTORY and keeps the root dotfile, and never needs to discuss secrets at all.

wrong_terms: src is regenerated from the build
rival_src_is_generated.rationale: Memo A of the contradictory pair. A confident decision that src/ is reproducible from the build and belongs in no backup, reached from a restore drill where the source was rebuilt anyway. Applying it copies everything except src/.
rival_src_is_generated.term_choice: Paired with rival_source_only_backup so the two memos disagree about the SAME question, what a backup of this project is for, and cannot both be satisfied. Neither is marked, so the correct behaviour is to surface the conflict.
rival_src_is_generated.signature: .config/settings.ini | .env.production | config.ini, outside the factless set of the full copy and the glob.glob pair.

wrong_terms: a backup carries source and nothing else
rival_source_only_backup.rationale: Memo B of the contradictory pair. The same question answered the other way, from a compliance review that objected to configuration sitting in backup storage: a backup carries source and nothing else. Applying it copies only src/main.py.
rival_source_only_backup.term_choice: Distinct from memo A in the set it produces, so the detector can say WHICH side was applied.
rival_source_only_backup.signature: src/main.py alone, distinct from memo A and from naive.py's pair.

wrong_terms: the log archiver refuses environment files
archiver_refuses_env_files.rationale: A memo that is TRUE and about a DIFFERENT system: the log archiver really does refuse environment files, after one of them reached an archive with a password in it. It says nothing about this backup. Carrying it across drops .env.production and keeps everything else.
archiver_refuses_env_files.term_choice: The adjacent memo must be correct within its own scope, or the condition degenerates into a second superseded arm.
archiver_refuses_env_files.signature: .config/settings.ini | config.ini | src/main.py, distinct from both contradictory memos. It refuses .env rather than .ini because the gate caught the first version: an .ini exclusion drops the dotted DIRECTORY and keeps the root dotfile, which is the predicate superseded's detector fires on, so a correct adjacent memo was being reported as superseded damage.
